overview.en: Pediatric GI disorders from vomiting/diarrhea to congenital anomalies (cleft lip/palate, TEF, pyloric stenosis, Hirschsprung, imperforate anus, abdominal wall defects), intussusception, appendicitis, celiac disease, hepatitis, poisonings (lead, acetaminophen, aspirin, corrosives) and parasites.
overview.zh: 小兒腸胃疾病：嘔吐與腹瀉、先天異常（唇顎裂、食道閉鎖與氣管食道瘻管、幽門狹窄、巨結腸症、肛門閉鎖、腹壁缺損）、腸套疊、闌尾炎、乳糜瀉、肝炎、中毒（鉛、乙醯胺酚、阿斯匹靈、腐蝕劑）與寄生蟲。

points.en: Vomiting risks: dehydration, electrolyte loss, metabolic alkalosis, aspiration. Position on side, monitor I&O, small frequent oral rehydration, antiemetics as ordered.
points.zh: 嘔吐風險：脫水、電解質流失、代謝性鹼中毒、吸入。側臥、監測輸出入、少量頻繁口服補液、依醫囑給止吐藥。

points.en: Projectile vomiting suggests pyloric stenosis or increased ICP; report blood in vomitus, forceful vomiting, abdominal pain.
points.zh: 噴射狀嘔吐提示幽門狹窄或顱內壓升高；嘔血、劇烈嘔吐、腹痛須通報。

points.en: Diarrhea risks: dehydration and metabolic acidosis, especially under 5 years; rotavirus is severe at 3-24 months and nosocomial.
points.zh: 腹瀉風險：脫水與代謝性酸中毒，尤其 5 歲以下；輪狀病毒在 3–24 個月最嚴重且可院內感染。

points.en: Enteric isolation, handwashing, skin care; ORS (Pedialyte) for mild-moderate; avoid carbonated drinks and apple juice; NPO plus IV for severe; give IV potassium only if voiding.
points.zh: 腸道隔離、洗手、皮膚護理；輕中度用口服補液鹽（Pedialyte）；避免碳酸飲料與蘋果汁；重度禁食加靜脈輸液；有排尿才給靜脈鉀。

points.en: Failure of tissues to fuse; folic acid before pregnancy lowers risk. Lip repair at 3-6 months; palate repair around 1 year. Risk of otitis media and hearing loss.
points.zh: 組織未融合；孕前補葉酸可降低風險。唇裂 3–6 個月修補；顎裂約 1 歲修補。易中耳炎與聽力損失。

points.en: Feeding: upright, formula to side/back of mouth, small amounts, burp often, special nipples; ESSR (enlarge nipple, stimulate suck, swallow, rest).
points.zh: 餵食：直立、奶流向口腔側後方、少量、常拍嗝、特殊奶嘴；ESSR（放大奶嘴、刺激吸吮、吞嚥、休息）。

points.en: After lip repair: protect suture line, keep clean, back-lying, no prone or on repair side, elbow restraints removed every 1-2 hours.
points.zh: 唇裂術後：保護縫線、保持清潔乾燥、仰臥、避免趴或壓術側、肘部約束每 1–2 小時鬆開。

points.en: After palate repair: nothing hard in mouth (no suction, straws, spoons, pacifiers, tongue depressor, thermometer); watch airway.
points.zh: 顎裂術後：口中不放硬物（不抽吸、吸管、湯匙、奶嘴、壓舌板、體溫計）；注意呼吸道。

heading.zh: 食道閉鎖/氣管食道瘻管與胃食道逆流

points.en: EA/TEF signs: frothy saliva, drooling, the 3 Cs (coughing, choking, cyanosis) with feeding, abdominal distention, respiratory distress.
points.zh: 食道閉鎖/瘻管徵象：口鼻泡沫唾液、流口水、餵食時 3C（咳、嗆、發紺）、腹脹、呼吸窘迫。

points.en: Preop: NPO, upright at least 30 degrees, suction blind pouch, IV fluids, antibiotics. Postop: watch for anastomotic leak, esophagogram before feeds; G-tube feeds around day 5-7.
points.zh: 術前：禁食、上半身抬高至少 30 度、抽吸盲袋、靜脈輸液、抗生素。術後：留意吻合處滲漏、進食前做食道攝影；約第 5–7 天經胃造瘻餵食。

points.en: GER: regurgitation, poor weight gain, irritability, respiratory problems; complications include esophagitis, strictures, FTT, aspiration pneumonia.
points.zh: GER：溢奶、體重增加差、易怒、呼吸問題；併發症有食道炎、狹窄、生長遲滯、吸入性肺炎。

points.en: Upright 20-30 minutes after feeds (not infant seat); small frequent feedings, thicken with rice cereal, burp often; supine for sleep; PPIs/H2 blockers.
points.zh: 餵後直立 20–30 分鐘（避免半臥嬰兒座椅）；少量多餐、可加米糊增稠、常拍嗝；睡眠仰臥；使用 PPI/H2 阻斷劑。

points.en: Avoid fatty foods, chocolate, tomato, carbonated and citrus drinks, spicy foods, vigorous play after eating.
points.zh: 避免油膩、巧克力、番茄、碳酸與柑橘飲料、辛辣食物、餐後劇烈活動。

heading.en: Pyloric stenosis, lactose intolerance, celiac disease
heading.zh: 幽門狹窄、乳糖不耐、乳糜瀉

points.en: Pyloric stenosis: first weeks of life; projectile non-bilious vomiting after feeds, hungry, visible peristaltic waves, olive-shaped mass; dehydration and metabolic alkalosis.
points.zh: 幽門狹窄：出生數週內；餵食後噴射狀非膽汁嘔吐、仍飢餓、可見蠕動波、橄欖狀腫塊；脫水與代謝性鹼中毒。

points.en: Pyloromyotomy: correct fluids/electrolytes first, NPO, NG decompression; postop small frequent feeds advanced gradually.
points.zh: 幽門肌切開術：先矯正水與電解質、禁食、NG 減壓；術後少量頻繁餵食逐步增加。

points.en: Lactose intolerance: lactase deficiency; bloating, cramps, diarrhea, flatus after dairy; use enzyme tablets, soy formula, hard cheese/yogurt; supplement calcium and vitamin D.
points.zh: 乳糖不耐：缺乏乳糖酶；進食乳製品後腹脹、絞痛、腹瀉、排氣；使用酵素錠、豆基配方、硬起司/優格；補充鈣與維生素 D。

points.en: Celiac disease: gluten (wheat, barley, rye, oats) damages villi; steatorrhea, distention, muscle wasting, anemia; onset 1-5 years.
points.zh: 乳糜瀉：麩質（小麥、大麥、裸麥、燕麥）損傷絨毛；脂肪便、腹脹、肌肉萎縮、貧血；1–5 歲發病。

points.en: Lifelong gluten-free diet (corn, rice, millet allowed) plus iron, folic acid, vitamins A, D, E, K; celiac crisis from fasting, infection or gluten: profuse diarrhea, dehydration, acidosis.
points.zh: 終身無麩質飲食（可吃玉米、米、小米）並補充鐵、葉酸、維生素 A、D、E、K；乳糜瀉危象由禁食、感染或麩質誘發：大量水瀉、脫水、酸中毒。

points.en: Pain starts periumbilical then localizes to RLQ at McBurney point; rebound tenderness, rigidity, low-grade fever, anorexia/nausea/vomiting after pain, elevated WBC.
points.zh: 疼痛起於臍周後移至右下腹 McBurney 點；反彈痛、僵硬、低燒、疼痛後才厭食噁心嘔吐、白血球升高。

points.en: Sudden relief of pain followed by worsening suggests perforation and peritonitis (fever, distention, tachycardia, pallor).
points.zh: 疼痛突然緩解後又加劇提示穿孔與腹膜炎（發燒、腹脹、心跳快、蒼白）。

points.en: Preop: NPO, IV fluids, antibiotics, position of comfort, ice if prescribed; NO heat, laxatives or enemas.
points.zh: 術前：禁食、靜脈輸液、抗生素、舒適姿勢、依醫囑冰敷；禁熱敷、瀉劑、灌腸。

points.en: Postop: monitor temperature, incision, drain; right side-lying or low semi-Fowler with legs flexed; NG suction; advance diet when bowel sounds return.
points.zh: 術後：監測體溫、傷口、引流；右側臥或低半坐臥並屈膝；NG 抽吸；腸音恢復後漸進飲食。

heading.en: Hirschsprung, intussusception, abdominal wall defects, hernia
heading.zh: 巨結腸症、腸套疊、腹壁缺損、疝氣

points.en: Hirschsprung: absent ganglion cells; newborn fails to pass meconium, abdominal distention, bile vomiting; later ribbon-like foul stools; enterocolitis is the serious complication (fever, explosive diarrhea). Biopsy diagnoses.
points.zh: 巨結腸症：缺乏神經節細胞；新生兒胎便未排、腹脹、膽汁嘔吐；之後絲帶狀惡臭便；腸炎為嚴重併發症（發燒、爆發性水瀉）。切片診斷。

points.en: Hirschsprung care: no rectal temperatures, measure girth, staged surgery with temporary colostomy; stoma should be red and moist.
points.zh: 巨結腸症照護：不量肛溫、量腹圍、分期手術含暫時性結腸造口；造口應紅潤濕潤。

points.en: Hirschsprung can run in families and is sometimes seen with Down syndrome or genitourinary anomalies. Mild-to-moderate disease may first be managed without surgery: a low-fiber, high-calorie, high-protein diet, stool softeners, and prescribed daily rectal irrigations to keep stool moving before surgery becomes necessary.
points.zh: 巨結腸症可能有家族傾向，也常合併唐氏症或泌尿生殖道異常。輕中度病例可先採非手術治療：低纖維、高熱量、高蛋白飲食，搭配軟便劑與醫囑每日直腸灌洗以維持排便，之後再評估是否需要手術。

points.en: Intussusception: colicky pain with knees drawn up, currant-jelly stool, sausage-shaped mass; hydrostatic (air/fluid) reduction if no perforation or shock; normal brown stool means reduction.
points.zh: 腸套疊：陣發性絞痛屈膝、果醬樣血便、香腸狀腫塊；無穿孔休克可行水（空氣）壓灌腸整復；排出正常棕色便代表已復位。

points.en: Omphalocele: covered sac, saline gauze plus plastic wrap, monitor temperature. Gastroschisis: no membrane, lateral to cord, loosely cover with saline pads, surgery within hours, prolonged ileus.
points.zh: 臍膨出：有囊膜，生理食鹽水紗布加塑膠膜、監測體溫。腹裂：無膜、位於臍側，生理食鹽水墊鬆覆蓋、數小時內手術、常有長期腸阻塞。

points.en: Incarcerated hernia (irritable, tender, nonreducible, distended) is an emergency. Hydrocele post-op: ice, scrotal support, no tub bath, no straddle toys 2-4 weeks.
points.zh: 嵌頓疝氣（易怒、壓痛、無法復位、腹脹）屬緊急。陰囊水腫術後：冰敷、陰囊托、避免盆浴、2–4 週不騎跨玩具。

points.en: Constipation/encopresis: fiber and fluids, less milk/sugar, enemas to clear impaction (watch hypernatremia, hyperphosphatemia), toilet sitting 5-10 minutes after meals, treatment 3-6 months.
points.zh: 便秘/大便失禁：高纖高水分、減少牛奶與糖、灌腸清除糞塊（留意高血鈉、高血磷）、餐後如廁坐 5–10 分鐘、治療 3–6 個月。

points.en: IBS: diffuse pain, alternating constipation/diarrhea with mucus; reassure, moderate fiber low fat, anticholinergics.
points.zh: 腸躁症：瀰漫性腹痛、便祕腹瀉交替含黏液；安撫、中等纖維低脂飲食、抗膽鹼藥。

points.en: Imperforate anus: no meconium, absent anus, anal membrane or fistula; stool in urine/vagina indicates fistula.
points.zh: 肛門閉鎖：無胎便、無肛門、肛膜或瘻管；尿或陰道有糞便代表瘻管。

points.en: Postop: side-lying prone with hips elevated, or legs suspended; no rectal temperatures; anal dilation only with provider-supplied dilator, 1-2 cm, water-soluble lubricant.
points.zh: 術後：側俯臥抬高臀部，或腿懸吊成 90 度；不量肛溫；僅用醫師提供之擴張器、插入 1–2 公分、水溶性潤滑劑。

points.en: HAV: fecal-oral; vaccine 2 doses from 12 months; enteric precautions at least 1 week after jaundice; may return to school 1 week after jaundice onset.
points.zh: A 肝：糞口傳染；12 個月起接種 2 劑疫苗；黃疸後至少 1 週腸道隔離；黃疸起 1 週後可返校。

points.en: HBV: mostly perinatal; vaccine before discharge then at 1 and 6 months; HBIG for newborns of HBsAg-positive mothers; can cause cirrhosis and liver cancer.
points.zh: B 肝：多為周產期傳染；出院前接種，之後 1 與 6 個月；母親 HBsAg 陽性新生兒給 HBIG；可致肝硬化與肝癌。

points.en: HCV parenteral and often chronic; HDV only with HBV; HEV uncommon, no chronic state.
points.zh: C 肝經血液傳染且常慢性化；D 肝僅與 B 肝併發；E 肝罕見且不慢性化。

points.en: Phases: anicteric prodrome 5-7 days (anorexia, malaise, RUQ pain); icteric phase (jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, pruritus).
points.zh: 分期：無黃疸前驅期 5–7 天（厭食、倦怠、右上腹痛）；黃疸期（黃疸、深色尿、灰白便、搔癢）。

points.en: Handwashing, standard and enteric precautions, bleach 1/4 cup per gallon for diaper surfaces, low-fat diet, caution with medications.
points.zh: 洗手、標準與腸道隔離、尿布區以 1/4 杯漂白水兌 1 加侖水消毒、低脂飲食、用藥需謹慎。

points.en: Poisoning first steps: ABCs, stop exposure, identify agent/amount, prevent absorption, call Poison Control.
points.zh: 中毒首要：ABC、終止暴露、辨識毒物與量、阻止吸收、聯絡毒物中心。

points.en: Lead: hand-to-mouth from paint chips/dust/pottery; CNS most affected; screen at 1-2 years; levels under 5 mcg/dL rescreen yearly, 20-44 treatment, 45-69 within 48 hr, 70 or more immediate.
points.zh: 鉛：經手口接觸漆片/灰塵/陶器；中樞神經最受影響；1–2 歲篩檢；<5 mcg/dL 每年複查，20–44 治療，45–69 於 48 小時內，≥70 立即處理。

points.en: Chelation: calcium disodium EDTA, succimer (oral), BAL (peanut oil: contraindicated with peanut allergy, G6PD deficiency, and iron). Ensure urine output first; monitor kidneys.
points.zh: 螯合治療：calcium disodium EDTA、succimer（口服）、BAL（花生油製劑：花生過敏、G6PD 缺乏、併用鐵劑者禁用）。先確認尿量；監測腎功能。

points.en: Acetaminophen toxic at 150 mg/kg or more; stages: GI symptoms, latent 24-36 h, hepatic injury; antidote N-acetylcysteine; charcoal if under 4 hours; do not use charcoal with NAC.
points.zh: 乙醯胺酚毒性劑量 ≥150 mg/kg；階段：腸胃症狀、24–36 小時潛伏期、肝損傷；解毒劑 N-acetylcysteine；<4 小時可給活性碳；活性碳不與 NAC 併用。

points.en: Aspirin: tinnitus, hyperpnea, fever, metabolic acidosis; charcoal, IV fluids, sodium bicarbonate, cooling, dialysis if needed.
points.zh: 阿斯匹靈：耳鳴、過度換氣、發燒、代謝性酸中毒；活性碳、靜脈輸液、碳酸氫鈉、降溫、必要時透析。

points.en: Corrosives: dilute with water/milk (up to 4 oz), do NOT induce vomiting or neutralize.
points.zh: 腐蝕劑：以水/牛奶稀釋（最多 4 盎司）、不可催吐、不可中和。

points.en: Giardiasis: protozoa in daycare; diarrhea, steatorrhea, cramps, FTT; 3 or more stool samples.
points.zh: 梨形鞭毛蟲症：日托常見；腹瀉、脂肪便、絞痛、生長遲滯；需 ≥3 次糞便檢體。

points.en: Pinworms: intense perianal itching, restless sleep; tape test in morning; flashlight inspection 2-3 hours after sleep.
points.zh: 蟯蟲：肛門劇癢、睡眠不安；晨間透明膠帶採檢；入睡後 2–3 小時以手電筒檢查。

points.en: Treat all family members; repeat medication in 2 weeks; hot-water laundry and meticulous handwashing.
points.zh: 全家同時治療；2 週後重複給藥；熱水洗衣並勤洗手。

critical_points.en: Pyloric stenosis: projectile non-bilious vomiting, olive-shaped mass, metabolic alkalosis.
critical_points.zh: 幽門狹窄：噴射狀非膽汁嘔吐、橄欖狀腫塊、代謝性鹼中毒。

critical_points.en: Intussusception: colicky pain, currant jelly stool, sausage-shaped mass; normal brown stool means self-reduction.
critical_points.zh: 腸套疊：絞痛、果醬樣便、香腸狀腫塊；排出正常棕色便表示自行復位。

critical_points.en: Appendicitis: never apply heat or give laxatives/enemas; sudden pain relief then worsening means rupture.
critical_points.zh: 闌尾炎：禁熱敷、瀉劑、灌腸；疼痛突然緩解後加劇＝破裂。

critical_points.en: Hirschsprung: no rectal temperatures; failure to pass meconium; ribbon-like stools; enterocolitis is serious.
critical_points.zh: 巨結腸症：不量肛溫；胎便未排；絲帶狀便；腸炎嚴重。

critical_points.en: Cleft lip repair: back-lying, protect suture line; no prone or repair-side positioning.
critical_points.zh: 唇裂修補後：仰臥、保護縫線；避免趴臥或壓術側。

critical_points.en: Palate repair: nothing in the mouth (no straws, spoons, pacifiers, suction).
critical_points.zh: 顎裂修補後：口中不放任何物品（吸管、湯匙、奶嘴、抽吸）。

critical_points.en: EA/TEF 3 Cs: coughing, choking, cyanosis with feeds; NPO and upright.
critical_points.zh: EA/TEF 三 C：餵食時咳、嗆、發紺；禁食並抬高上身。

critical_points.en: Gastroschisis: loose saline pads, never wrap tightly around bowel; urgent surgery.
critical_points.zh: 腹裂：鬆覆生理食鹽水墊，勿緊包腸管；緊急手術。

critical_points.en: Persistent vomiting leads to metabolic alkalosis; diarrhea leads to metabolic acidosis.
critical_points.zh: 持續嘔吐致代謝性鹼中毒；腹瀉致代謝性酸中毒。

critical_points.en: Lead levels: under 5 rescreen; 45-69 manage within 48 h; 70+ immediate; BAL contraindicated in peanut allergy/G6PD.
critical_points.zh: 鉛濃度：<5 複查；45–69 於 48 小時內處理；≥70 立即；花生過敏/G6PD 缺乏禁用 BAL。

critical_points.en: Acetaminophen overdose antidote: N-acetylcysteine; toxic dose 150 mg/kg.
critical_points.zh: 乙醯胺酚過量解毒劑：N-acetylcysteine；毒性劑量 150 mg/kg。

critical_points.en: Corrosive ingestion: no induced vomiting, no neutralization; dilute with water or milk.
critical_points.zh: 腐蝕劑吞食：禁催吐、禁中和；以水或牛奶稀釋。

critical_points.en: Celiac: lifelong avoidance of wheat, barley, rye, oats; corn, rice, millet allowed.
critical_points.zh: 乳糜瀉：終身避免小麥、大麥、裸麥、燕麥；可吃玉米、米、小米。

critical_points.en: GER: upright 20-30 min after feeds, thicken with rice cereal, supine for sleep.
critical_points.zh: GER：餵後直立 20–30 分鐘、米糊增稠、睡眠仰臥。

critical_points.en: Pinworm tape test in the morning; treat whole family; repeat in 2 weeks.
critical_points.zh: 蟯蟲晨間膠帶法；全家治療；2 週後重複。

mnemonics.en: Hirschsprung = Hold the thermometer (no rectal temps).

mnemonics.zh: 腸套疊＝果醬便＋香腸＋絞痛。

stem.zh: 新生兒何項表現最提示食道閉鎖併瘻管？

rationale.en: Coughing, choking and cyanosis with feeds are the 3 Cs.
rationale.zh: 餵食時咳嗆發紺為三 C。

stem.en: Which instruction helps reduce emesis in infant GER?
stem.zh: 何項指導可減少 GER 嬰兒的嘔吐？

rationale.en: Small frequent feeds, thickening and upright positioning help.
rationale.zh: 少量多餐、增稠與直立有幫助。

stem.en: A child with persistent vomiting is monitored for which acid-base problem?
stem.zh: 持續嘔吐孩童需監測何種酸鹼問題？

rationale.en: Loss of gastric HCl causes alkalosis; diarrhea causes acidosis.
rationale.zh: 胃酸流失致鹼中毒；腹瀉致酸中毒。

stem.en: Which prescriptions would the nurse question for a child with appendicitis? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 闌尾炎孩童，哪些醫囑護理師應質疑？（多選）

rationale.en: Heat and enemas may cause rupture.
rationale.zh: 熱敷與灌腸可能導致破裂。

stem.en: A 2-year-old swallowed a corrosive cleaner. What is contraindicated?
stem.zh: 2 歲幼兒吞入腐蝕性清潔劑，何者禁忌？

rationale.en: Vomiting re-injures mucosa; neutralizing causes heat.
rationale.zh: 催吐會再次傷害黏膜；中和會產熱。

stem.en: Which statements are correct about celiac disease? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 關於乳糜瀉何者正確？（多選）

options.en: Avoid wheat, rye, barley and oats
options.zh: 避免小麥、裸麥、大麥與燕麥

options.en: Diet is needed only during flare-ups

options.zh: 補充脂溶性維生素與鐵

stem.en: A pinworm infestation is suspected. When should the tape test be performed?
stem.zh: 懷疑蟯蟲感染，何時做膠帶採檢？

rationale.en: Females lay eggs at night; collect in the morning.
rationale.zh: 雌蟲夜間產卵；晨間採檢。
